WITH transaction_sentiment_data AS (
  SELECT 
    tr.transreg,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    sf.shortintrt,
    sf.optvolrt
  FROM transactionrecord tr
  INNER JOIN sentimentandfundamentals sf ON sf.transref = tr.transreg
),
transaction_aggregates AS (
  SELECT 
    transreg,
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(shortintrt) as avg_short_int,
    AVG(optvolrt) as avg_opt_vol
  FROM transaction_sentiment_data
  GROUP BY transreg, ordertypedist
),
order_type_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    AVG(avg_short_int) as baseline_short_int
  FROM transaction_aggregates
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  ta.transreg,
  ta.ordertypedist,
  ta.avg_short_int,
  ta.avg_opt_vol,
  CASE 
    WHEN otb.baseline_short_int IS NOT NULL AND ta.avg_short_int IS NOT NULL
    THEN ta.avg_short_int / otb.baseline_short_int
    ELSE NULL
  END as short_int_ratio
FROM transaction_aggregates ta
LEFT JOIN order_type_baselines otb ON ta.ordertypedist = otb.ordertypedist
ORDER BY 
  short_int_ratio IS NULL,
  short_int_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
